description: Source code for exporting user data to CSV in Mattermost, including worker creation, job metadata parsing, and data retrieval functions.

classes.name: ExportUsersToCSVAppIFace
classes.description: Interface for the application layer providing user reporting and batch worker functionalities.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Creates a batch report worker for generating CSV user reports.

methods.name: parseJobMetadata
methods.description: Parses job metadata to produce user report options for batch processing.

methods.name: makeJobMetadata
methods.description: Encodes last processed user info into job metadata for continuation.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a function that fetches user data for reporting based on job metadata.
